description: Each problem lists the nodes it exercises. 'core' = the problem exists to test this node; failure is strong evidence. 'supporting' = needed but incidental; failure is weaker evidence and often points to a prerequisite. 'approaches[].demonstrates' lets the grader credit nodes based on which approach the user actually wrote.
